133ZOperandContent::_copyFrom(const ZOperandContent& pIn) {
134 clear();
135
136 OperandZSTO = pIn.OperandZSTO;
137 /*
138 String = pIn.String;
139 URI = pIn.URI;
140 Integer = pIn.Integer;

143 Bool = pIn.Bool;
144 Date = pIn.Date;
145 Resource = pIn.Resource;
146*/
147
148 if (pIn.isNull())
149 return *this;
150
151 ZSearchOperandType_type wZSTO = OperandZSTO&ZSTO_BaseMask;
152
153 switch (wZSTO)
154 {
155 case ZSTO_String:
156 {
157 utf8VaryingString* wContent=static_cast<utf8VaryingString*>(pIn.Value);
158 Value=new utf8VaryingString(*wContent);
159 }
160 case ZSTO_Integer:
161 {
162 long* wContent=static_cast<long*>(pIn.Value);
163 Value=new long(*wContent);
164 break;
165 }
166 case ZSTO_Float:
167 {
168 double* wContent=static_cast<double*>(pIn.Value);
169 Value=new double(*wContent);
170 break;
171 }
172 case ZSTO_Bool:
173 {
174 bool* wContent=static_cast<bool*>(pIn.Value);
175 Value=new bool(*wContent);
176 break;
177 }
178 case ZSTO_Checksum:
179 {
180 checkSum* wContent=static_cast<checkSum*>(pIn.Value);
181 Value=new checkSum(*wContent);
182 break;
183 }
184 case ZSTO_Resource:
185 {
186 ZResource* wContent=static_cast<ZResource*>(pIn.Value);
187 Value=new ZResource(*wContent);
188 break;
189 }
190 case ZSTO_Date:
191 {
192 ZDateFull* wContent=static_cast<ZDateFull*>(pIn.Value);
193 Value=new ZDateFull(*wContent);
194 break;
195 }
196 case ZSTO_UriString:
197 {
198 uriString* wContent=static_cast<uriString*>(pIn.Value);
199 Value=new uriString(*wContent);
200 break;
201 }
202 default:
203 _DBGPRINT("ZOperandContent::_copyFrom Invalid operand type 0x%X.",wZSTO)
204 return *this;
205 } // switch
206
207 return *this;
208}

733 ZSearchOperandType_type wZSTO = OperandZSTO & ZSTO_BaseMask ;
734 switch (wZSTO)
735 {
736 case ZSTO_Integer:
737 {
738 long wValue=*static_cast<long*>(Value);
739 size_t wL=getAtomicURFSize<long>(wValue);
740 unsigned char* wPtr=pURFBuffer.extend(wL);
741 exportAtomicURF_Ptr<long>(wValue,wPtr);
742 return ZS_SUCCESS;
743 }
744 case ZSTO_Bool:
745 {
746 bool wValue=*static_cast<bool*>(Value);
747 size_t wL=getAtomicURFSize<bool>(wValue);
748 unsigned char* wPtr=pURFBuffer.extend(wL);
749 exportAtomicURF_Ptr<bool>(wValue,wPtr);
750 return ZS_SUCCESS;
751 }
752 case ZSTO_Float:
753 {
754 bool wValue=*static_cast<double*>(Value);
755 size_t wL=getAtomicURFSize<double>(wValue);
756 unsigned char* wPtr=pURFBuffer.extend(wL);
757 exportAtomicURF_Ptr<double>(wValue,wPtr);
758 return ZS_SUCCESS;
759 }
760
761 case ZSTO_String:
762 {
763 utf8VaryingString* wValue=static_cast<utf8VaryingString*>(Value);
764 wValue->_exportURF(pURFBuffer);
765 return ZS_SUCCESS;
766 }
767 case ZSTO_UriString:
768 {
769 uriString* wValue=static_cast<uriString*>(Value);
770 wValue->_exportURF(pURFBuffer);
771 return ZS_SUCCESS;
772 }
773 case ZSTO_Date:
774 {
775 ZDateFull* wValue=static_cast<ZDateFull*>(Value);
776 wValue->_exportURF(pURFBuffer);
777 return ZS_SUCCESS;
778 }
779 case ZSTO_Resource:
780 {
781 ZResource* wValue=static_cast<ZResource*>(Value);
782 wValue->_exportURF(pURFBuffer);
783 return ZS_SUCCESS;
784 }
785 case ZSTO_Checksum:
786 {
787 checkSum* wValue=static_cast<checkSum*>(Value);
788 wValue->_exportURF(pURFBuffer);
789 return ZS_SUCCESS;
790 }
791 default:
792 {
793 _DBGPRINT("ZOperandContent::appendURF-E Invalid operand content type 0x%X %s while expecting of of ZSTO_Bool,...\n",
794 OperandZSTO , decode_OperandType(OperandZSTO))
795 return ZS_INVTYPE;
796 }
797 }// switch
798 return ZS_INVTYPE;
799} //ZOperandContent::appendURF
800
801 utf8VaryingString ZOperandContent::displayContent()
802{
803 utf8VaryingString wReturn;
804
805 ZSearchOperandType_type wBaseZSTO = OperandZSTO & ZSTO_BaseMask;
806 switch (wBaseZSTO)
807 {
808 case ZSTO_Integer:
809 wReturn.sprintf("%ld",getInteger());
810
811 case ZSTO_Float:
812 wReturn.sprintf("%g",getFloat());
813
814 case ZSTO_String:
815 return getString();
816 case ZSTO_UriString:
817 return getURI();
818
819 case ZSTO_FieldBool:
820 return getBool()?"TRUE":"FALSE";
821
822 case ZSTO_Date:
823 return getDate().toFormatted();
824
825 case ZSTO_Resource:
826 {
827 long wi=0;
828 for (;wi < ZEntitySymbolList.count();wi++) {
829 if (ZEntitySymbolList[wi].Value==getResource().Entity) {
830 break;
831 }
832 }// for
833 if (wi==ZEntitySymbolList.count())
834 wReturn.sprintf("ZResource(%6X,%6X)",getResource().Entity,getResource().id);
835 else
836 wReturn.sprintf("ZResource(%s,%6X)",ZEntitySymbolList[wi].Symbol.toString(),getResource().id);
837 return wReturn;
838 } //ZSTO_Resource
839 case ZSTO_Checksum:
840 return getChecksum().toHexa();
841 }
842 return wReturn;
843

1027ZSearchOperator::_report(int pLevel)
1028{

1030 if (ZSOPV & ZSOPV_AND) {
1031 wReturn="ZSOPV_AND";
1032 }
1033 if (ZSOPV & ZSOPV_OR) {
1034 wReturn.addConditionalOR("ZSOPV_OR");
1035 }
1036 if (ZSOPV & ZSOPV_NOT) {
1037 wReturn.addConditionalOR("ZSOPV_NOT");
1038 }
1039
1040
1041 if (ZSOPV & ZSOPV_EQUAL) {
1042 wReturn.addConditionalOR("ZSOPV_EQUAL");
1043 }
1044 if (ZSOPV & ZSOPV_NOTEQUAL) {
1045 wReturn.addConditionalOR("ZSOPV_NOTEQUAL");
1046 }
1047 if (ZSOPV & ZSOPV_LESS) {
1048 wReturn.addConditionalOR("ZSOPV_LESS");
1049 }
1050 if (ZSOPV & ZSOPV_GREATER) {
1051 wReturn.addConditionalOR("ZSOPV_GREATER");
1052 }
1053 if (ZSOPV & ZSOPV_LESSEQUAL) {
1054 wReturn.addConditionalOR("ZSOPV_LESSEQUAL");
1055 }
1056 if (ZSOPV & ZSOPV_GREATEREQUAL) {
1057 wReturn.addConditionalOR("ZSOPV_GREATEREQUAL");
1058 }
1059
1060 if (ZSOPV & ZSOPV_CONTAINS) {
1061 wReturn.addConditionalOR("ZSOPV_CONTAINS");
1062 }
1063 if (ZSOPV & ZSOPV_STARTS_WITH) {
1064 wReturn.addConditionalOR("ZSOPV_STARTS_WITH");
1065 }
1066 if (ZSOPV & ZSOPV_ENDS_WITH) {
1067 wReturn.addConditionalOR("ZSOPV_ENDS_WITH");
1068 }
1069
1070
1071
1072 if (ZSOPV & ZSOPV_PLUS) {
1073 wReturn.addConditionalOR("ZSOPV_PLUS");
1074 }
1075 if (ZSOPV & ZSOPV_MINUS) {
1076 wReturn.addConditionalOR("ZSOPV_MINUS");
1077 }
1078 if (ZSOPV & ZSOPV_DIVIDE) {
1079 wReturn.addConditionalOR("ZSOPV_DIVIDE");
1080 }
1081 if (ZSOPV & ZSOPV_MULTIPLY) {
1082 wReturn.addConditionalOR("ZSOPV_MULTIPLY");
1083 }
1084 if (ZSOPV & ZSOPV_POWER) {
1085 wReturn.addConditionalOR("ZSOPV_POWER");
1086 }
1087 if (ZSOPV & ZSOPV_MODULO) {
1088 wReturn.addConditionalOR("ZSOPV_MODULO");
1089 }
1090
1091 if (wReturn.isEmpty()) {
1092 wReturn = "End-no operator";
1093 }
1094
1095 wRet.sprintf ("%*c%s\n",pLevel,' ', wReturn.toString());
1096 return wRet;
1097} //ZSearchOperator::_report

1128ZSearchLogicalOperand::_evaluateOpLiteral(void *pOp)
1129{
1130 utf8VaryingString wReturn;
1131
1132 if (!(static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(pOp)->ZSTO & ZSTO_Literal)) {
1133 wReturn.sprintf("_evaluateOpLiteral-E-INVTYP Invalid type to evaluate <%s>",
1134 decode_OperandType(static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(pOp)->ZSTO));
1135 return wReturn;
1136 }
1137
1138 ZSearchLiteral* wOp = static_cast<ZSearchLiteral*>(pOp);
1139
1140 switch (static_cast<const ZSearchOperandBase*>(pOp)->ZSTO )
1141 {
1142 case ZSTO_LiteralString:
1143 {
1144 // ZSearchLiteral<utf8VaryingString>* wOp=static_cast<ZSearchLiteral<utf8VaryingString>*>(pOp);
1145 wReturn.sprintf("\"%s\"",wOp->getString().toString());
1146// return wOp->Content;
1147 return wReturn;
1148 }
1149 case ZSTO_LiteralUriString:
1150 {
1151// ZSearchLiteral<uriString>* wOp=static_cast<ZSearchLiteral<uriString>*>(pOp);
1152 wReturn.sprintf("\"%s\"",wOp->getURI().toString());
1153 return wReturn;
1154 }
1155 case ZSTO_LiteralInteger:
1156 {
1157// ZSearchLiteral<long>* wOp=static_cast<ZSearchLiteral<long>*>(pOp);
1158 wReturn.sprintf("%ld",wOp->getInteger());
1159 return wReturn;
1160 }
1161 case ZSTO_LiteralFloat:
1162 {
1163// ZSearchLiteral<double>* wOp=static_cast<ZSearchLiteral<double>*>(pOp);
1164 wReturn.sprintf("%g",wOp->getFloat());
1165 return wReturn;
1166 }
1167 case ZSTO_LiteralDate:
1168 {
1169// ZSearchLiteral<ZDateFull>* wOp=static_cast<ZSearchLiteral<ZDateFull>*>(pOp);
1170 return wOp->getDate().toLocale();
1171 }
1172 case ZSTO_LiteralResource:
1173 {
1174// ZSearchLiteral<ZResource>* wOp=static_cast<ZSearchLiteral<ZResource>*>(pOp);
1175// return wOp->Content.toHexa();
1176 long wi=0;
1177 for (;wi < ZEntitySymbolList.count();wi++) {
1178 if (ZEntitySymbolList[wi].Value==wOp->getResource().Entity) {
1179 break;
1180 }
1181 }// for
1182 if (wi==ZEntitySymbolList.count())
1183 wReturn.sprintf("ZResource(%6X,%6X)",wOp->getResource().Entity,wOp->getResource().id);
1184 else
1185 wReturn.sprintf("ZResource(%s,%6X)",ZEntitySymbolList[wi].Symbol.toString(),wOp->getResource().id);
1186 return wReturn;
1187 }
1188 case ZSTO_LiteralBool:
1189 {
1190// ZSearchLiteral<bool>* wOp=static_cast<ZSearchLiteral<bool>*>(pOp);
1191 return wOp->getBool()?"TRUE":"FALSE";
1192 }
1193 case ZSTO_LiteralChecksum:
1194 {
1195// ZSearchLiteral<checkSum>* wOp=static_cast<ZSearchLiteral<checkSum>*>(pOp);
1196// return wOp->Content.toHexa();
1197 wReturn.sprintf("checkSum(%s)",wOp->getChecksum().toHexa().toString());
1198 return wReturn;
1199 }
1200 default:
1201 {
1202 wReturn.sprintf("_evaluateOpLiteral-E-INVTYP Invalid type to evaluate <%s>",
1203 decode_OperandType(static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(pOp)->ZSTO));
1204 return wReturn;
1205 }
1206
1207 }// switch
1208}

1211ZOperandContent::display()

1273ZStatus buildOperandContent(ZSearchEntityContext &pSEC, void *pOp, ZOperandContent *pOperandContent)
1274{
1275 pOperandContent->clear();
1276 ZSearchOperandType_type wZSTO = static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*> (pOp)->ZSTO;
1277 ZStatus wSt=ZS_SUCCESS;
1278 if (wZSTO==ZSTO_Logical) {
1279 /* Operand is a logical expression.
1280 * It returns a boolean
1281 * Operator is a logical link {AND,OR} to OperandNext */
1282 pOperandContent->OperandZSTO = ZSTO_Logical; /* This is a logical expression - type is bool */
1283 _DBGPRINT("getOperandContent Operand is a logical expression : evaluation ")
1284 pOperandContent->setBool( static_cast<ZSearchLogicalOperand*> (pOp)->evaluate(pSEC));
1285 _DBGPRINT(pOperandContent->display().toCChar())
1286 return ZS_SUCCESS;
1287 }
1288 /* Operand is an arithmetic expression.
1289 * result of an arithmetic expression is a qualified literal and must be processed as a literal constant
1290 */
1291 if (wZSTO & ZSTO_Arithmetic) {
1292 _DBGPRINT("getOperandContent Operand is an arithmetic expression ")
1293 ZSearchOperandType_type wArithmeticType=ZSTO_Arithmetic;
1294 ZSearchArithmeticTerm* wSLOP=static_cast<ZSearchArithmeticTerm*>(pOp);
1295 wSt=computeArithmetic(pSEC,wSLOP,wArithmeticType,*pOperandContent);
1296 _DBGPRINT(pOperandContent->display().toCChar())
1297 return wSt;
1298 }
1299 /* operand is not an expression
1300 * It is either a field operand or a literal operand
1301 * get Next operand and evaluate expression
1302 */
1303 _DBGPRINT("getOperandContent Operand is a valid operand either field or arithmetic\n")
1304// wSt = extractOperandContent(pOp,pURFParser,pOperandContent);
1305 wSt = extractOperandContent(pSEC,pOp,pOperandContent);
1306
1307 _DBGPRINT("getOperandContent resulting value %s\n", pOperandContent->display().toCChar())
1308 return wSt;
1309}
1310/*
1311ZOperandContent
1312ZSearchLogicalOperand::getContent(URFParser& pURFParser) {
1313 return getOperandContent(Operand,pURFParser);
1314}
1315*/
1316
1317bool
1318ZSearchLogicalOperand::evaluate(ZSearchEntityContext &pSEC)
1319{
1320 ZOperandContent wOperandContent;
1321 ZStatus wSt = buildOperandContent(pSEC,Operand,&wOperandContent);
1322 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
1323 return false;
1324 return wOperandContent.getBool();
1325} //ZSearchLogicalOperand::evaluate

1328utf8VaryingString
1329ZSearchLogicalOperand::_reportDetailed(int pLevel)
1330{
1331 utf8VaryingString wReturn;
1332 ZSearchOperandBase* wOpBase = static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(Operand);
1333 wReturn.addsprintf("%*cOperand\n",pLevel,' ');
1334 while (true) {
1335 if (wOpBase->ZSTO == ZSTO_Arithmetic) {
1336 wReturn += static_cast<ZSearchArithmeticTerm*>(Operand)->_report(pLevel+1);
1337 break;
1338 }
1339 if (wOpBase->ZSTO == ZSTO_Logical) {
1340 wReturn += static_cast<ZSearchLogicalTerm*>(Operand)->_report(pLevel+1);
1341 break;
1342 }
1343
1344 if (wOpBase->ZSTO & ZSTO_Field) {
1345 ZSearchFieldOperand* wFldData = static_cast<ZSearchFieldOperand*>( Operand);
1346 wReturn.addsprintf("%*ctype %s full field name <%s> type <%s>",
1347 pLevel,' ',
1348 decode_OperandType(wOpBase->ZSTO),
1349 wFldData->FullFieldName.toString(),
1350 decode_ZSearchType(wFldData->ZSTO)
1351 );
1352 break;
1353 }
1354 if (wOpBase->ZSTO & ZSTO_Literal) {
1355 wReturn.addsprintf("%*c type %s value <%s>",
1356 pLevel,' ',
1357 decode_OperandType(wOpBase->ZSTO),
1358 _evaluateOpLiteral(Operand).toString()
1359 );
1360 break;
1361 }
1362 wReturn.addsprintf("%*c type %s <Invalid type>\n",
1363 pLevel,' ',
1364 decode_OperandType(wOpBase->ZSTO)
1365 );
1366 break;
1367 }// while true
1368
1369 wReturn += _reportModifier(pLevel);
1370 wReturn += "\n";
1371
1372 return wReturn;
1373} // ZSearchLogicalOperand::_reportDetailed

1432ZSearchLogicalOperand::_reportBrief(int pLevel)
1433{
1434 utf8VaryingString wReturn;
1435 ZSearchOperandBase* wOpBase = static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(Operand);
1436 while (true) {
1437 if (wOpBase->ZSTO == ZSTO_Arithmetic) {
1438 wReturn += static_cast<ZSearchArithmeticTerm*>(Operand)->_reportFormula(pLevel+1);
1439 break;
1440 }
1441 if (wOpBase->ZSTO == ZSTO_Logical) {
1442 wReturn += static_cast<ZSearchLogicalTerm*>(Operand)->_reportFormula(pLevel+1);
1443 break;
1444 }
1445
1446 if (wOpBase->ZSTO & ZSTO_Field) {
1447 ZSearchFieldOperand* wFldData = static_cast<ZSearchFieldOperand*>( Operand);
1448 wReturn.addsprintf("%s", wFldData->FullFieldName.toString() );
1449 break;
1450 }
1451 if (wOpBase->ZSTO & ZSTO_Literal) {
1452 wReturn.addsprintf("%s",_evaluateOpLiteral(Operand).toString()
1453 );
1454 break;
1455 }
1456 wReturn.addsprintf("type %X <Invalid operand type>", wOpBase->ZSTO);
1457 break;
1458 }// while true
1459
1460 wReturn += _reportModifierBrief();
1461 // wReturn += "\n";
1462
1463 return wReturn;
1464} // ZSearchLogicalOperand::_report

1691utf8VaryingString
1692ZSearchLogicalOperand::_reportFormula()
1693{
1694 utf8VaryingString wReturn;
1695
1696 while (true) {
1697 if (static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(Operand)->ZSTO == ZSTO_Arithmetic) {
1698 wReturn += static_cast<ZSearchArithmeticTerm*>(Operand)->_reportFormula();
1699 break;
1700 }
1701 if (static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(Operand)->ZSTO == ZSTO_Logical) {
1702 wReturn += static_cast<ZSearchLogicalTerm*>(Operand)->_reportFormula(true);
1703 break;
1704 }
1705
1706 if (static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(Operand)->ZSTO & ZSTO_Field) {
1707 ZSearchFieldOperand* wFldData = static_cast<ZSearchFieldOperand*>( Operand);
1708
1709 wReturn.addsprintf(" %s ", wFldData->FullFieldName.toString() );
1710 break;
1711 }
1712 if (static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(Operand)->ZSTO & ZSTO_Literal) {
1713 wReturn.addsprintf(" %s",_evaluateOpLiteral(Operand).toString() );
1714 break;
1715 }
1716 wReturn.addsprintf("type %s <Invalid type>\n",
1717 decode_OperandType(static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(Operand)->ZSTO) );
1718 break;
1719 }// while true
1720
1721 if (static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(Operand)->ModifierType!=ZSRCH_NOTHING){
1722 wReturn+=static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(Operand)->_reportModifierBrief();
1723 }
1724
1725 if (!static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(Operand)->FullFieldName.isEmpty()) {
1726 wReturn.addsprintf("(%s)",static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(Operand)->FullFieldName.toString());
1727 }
1728 wReturn += " ";
1729
1730 return wReturn;
1731} // ZSearchLogicalOperand::_report
1732
1733
1734utf8VaryingString
1735ZSearchArithmeticTerm::_report(int pLevel)
1736{
1737 utf8VaryingString wReturn;
1738 ZSearchOperandBase* wOpBase = static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(Operand);
1739
1740 wReturn.sprintf("%*cArithmetic operand Parenthesis level %d collateral %d\n",pLevel,' ',ParenthesisLevel);
1741
1742 wReturn.addsprintf("%*cOperand\n",pLevel,' ');
1743 while (true) {
1744 if (wOpBase->ZSTO == ZSTO_Arithmetic) {
1745 wReturn += static_cast<ZSearchArithmeticTerm*>(Operand)->_report(pLevel+1);
1746 break;
1747 }
1748
1749 if (wOpBase->ZSTO & ZSTO_Field) {
1750 ZSearchFieldOperand* wFldData = static_cast<ZSearchFieldOperand*>( Operand);
1751 wReturn.addsprintf("%*c type %s full field name <%s> type <%s>\n",
1752 pLevel,' ',
1753 decode_OperandType(static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(Operand)->ZSTO),
1754 wFldData->FullFieldName.toString(),
1755 decode_ZSearchType(wFldData->ZSTO)
1756 );
1757 break;
1758 }
1759 if (wOpBase->ZSTO & ZSTO_Literal) {
1760 wReturn.addsprintf("%*c type %s value <%s>\n",
1761 pLevel,' ',
1762 decode_OperandType(static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(Operand)->ZSTO),
1763 ZSearchLogicalOperand::_evaluateOpLiteral(Operand).toString()
1764 );
1765 break;
1766 }
1767 wReturn.addsprintf("%*c type %s <Invalid type>\n",
1768 pLevel,' ',
1769 decode_OperandType(wOpBase->ZSTO)
1770 );
1771 break;
1772/*
1773 if (static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(Operand)->TokenList.count()>0) {
1774 wReturn.addsprintf("%*c Tokens <",pLevel,' ');
1775 for (int wj=0; wj < static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(Operand)->TokenList.count();wj++) {
1776 wReturn.addsprintf("%s",static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(Operand)->TokenList[wj]->Text.toString());
1777 }
1778 wReturn += ">\n";
1779 } else {
1780 wReturn.addsprintf("%*c No Token for this operand\n",pLevel,' ');
1781 }
1782*/
1783 // setMaxSprintfBufferCount(4096);
1784
1785 if (wOpBase->ModifierType!=ZSRCH_NOTHING){
1786 wReturn += wOpBase->_reportModifier(pLevel);
1787 wReturn += "\n";
1788 }
1789 }// while true
1790
1791 wReturn.addsprintf("%*cOperator\n",pLevel,' ');
1792 wReturn += Operator._report(pLevel+1);
1793
1794 if (OperandNext==nullptr) {
1795 wReturn.addsprintf("%*cNext arithmetic operand is <nullptr>\n",pLevel,' ');
1796 return wReturn;
1797 }
1798
1799 wReturn += static_cast<ZSearchArithmeticTerm*>(OperandNext)->_report(pLevel);
1800 return wReturn;
1801} // ZSearchArithmeticTerm::_report
1802
1803utf8VaryingString
1804ZSearchArithmeticTerm::_reportFormula(bool pDetailed)
1805{
1806 utf8VaryingString wReturn;
1807
1808 while (true) {
1809 if (static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(Operand)->ZSTO == ZSTO_Arithmetic) {
1810 wReturn += " ( ";
1811 wReturn = static_cast<ZSearchArithmeticTerm*>(Operand)->_reportFormula(pDetailed);
1812 wReturn += " ) ";
1813 break;
1814 }
1815
1816 wReturn += OperandReportFormula(Operand);
1817 break;
1818/*
1819 if (static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(Operand)->Type & ZSTO_Field) {
1820 ZSearchFieldOperandOwnData* wFldOwnData = static_cast<ZSearchFieldOperandOwnData*>( Operand);
1821 wReturn.addsprintf(" %s", wFldOwnData->FullFieldName.toString() );
1822 break;
1823 }
1824 if (static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(Operand)->Type & ZSTO_Literal) {
1825 wReturn.addsprintf(" %s", ZSearchLogicalOperand::_evaluateOpLiteral(Operand).toString() );
1826 break;
1827 }
1828
1829 wReturn.addsprintf("%s <Invalid type> ", decode_OperandType(static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(Operand)->Type) );
1830 break;
1831*/
1832
1833 }// while true
1834
1835 if (static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(Operand)->ModifierType!=ZSRCH_NOTHING){
1836 wReturn += static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(Operand)->_reportModifierBrief();
1837 }
1838
1839 wReturn += " ";
1840
1841 wReturn += Operator._reportFormula();
1842
1843
1844 if (OperandNext==nullptr) {
1845 if (pDetailed)
1846 wReturn += "<nullptr>";
1847 return wReturn;
1848 }
1849
1850 wReturn += static_cast<ZSearchArithmeticTerm*>(OperandNext)->_reportFormula(pDetailed);
1851 return wReturn;
1852} // ZSearchArithmeticTerm::_report

1898
1899ZStatus setStringOperandModifierValue(utf8VaryingString &pRawValue,
1900 ZSearchTokentype_type pModifier,
1901 void* pModParams,
1902 ZOperandContent* pOperandContent)
1903{
1904 ZStatus wSt=ZS_SUCCESS;
1905 pOperandContent->OperandZSTO = ZSTO_String;
1906 switch (pModifier) /* NB: Content ZType remains the same */
1907 {
1908 case ZSRCH_NOTHING: /* No modifier */
1909 case ZSRCH_TRANSLATE: /* if translate, then source value must be set to current operand */
1910 {
1911 wSt=pOperandContent->setString ( pRawValue);
1912 break;
1913 }
1914
1915 case ZSRCH_SUBSTRING:
1916 {
1917 Mod_SubString* wMP=static_cast<Mod_SubString*>(pModParams);
1918 wSt=pOperandContent->setString ( pRawValue.subString(wMP->Offset,wMP->Length) );
1919 break;
1920 }
1921 case ZSRCH_SUBSTRINGRIGHT:
1922 {
1923 Mod_LeftRight* wMP=static_cast<Mod_LeftRight*>(pModParams);
1924 wSt=pOperandContent->setString ( pRawValue.Right( wMP->Length) );
1925 break;
1926 }
1927 case ZSRCH_SUBSTRINGLEFT:
1928 {
1929 Mod_LeftRight* wMP=static_cast<Mod_LeftRight*>(pModParams);
1930 wSt=pOperandContent->setString ( pRawValue.Left( wMP->Length) );
1931 break;
1932 }
1933
1934 default:
1935 return ZS_INVTYPE;
1936 }// switch pModifier
1937
1938 return wSt ;
1939}// setStringOperandModifierValue

2296
2297 break;

2299 case ZSRCH_BASENAME:
2300 {

2318 wField.ZType,

2320 return ZS_INVTYPE;

2322 break;

2324
2325 default:
2326 _DBGPRINT("Cannot convert data type %s - data type not supported.",decode_ZType(wField.ZType))
2327 return ZS_INVTYPE;
2328 }//switch
2329
2330 if (pModifier==ZSRCH_TRANSLATE) {
2331 ZArray<URFField> wFieldList;
2332 ZDataBuffer wRecord;
2333 Mod_Translate* wMD=static_cast<Mod_Translate*>(pModParams);
2334 ZStatus wSt=ZS_SUCCESS;
2335 wSt=wMD->Entity->findFirstFieldValueSequential(pSEC,wMD->KeyDicRank,pOperandContent,wRecord);
2336 if (wSt==ZS_FOUND) {
2337
2338 return getURFOperandContentWModifier(pSEC,pSEC._URFParser.URFFieldList[wMD->ResultDicRank],ZSRCH_NOTHING,nullptr, pOperandContent);
2339 }
2340 return wSt;
2341 } // ZSRCH_DECODE
2342
2343
2344
2345 _DBGPRINT("getFieldOperandContent field type <%s> operand type<%s> value <%s>\n",
2346 decode_ZType(wField.ZType),decode_OperandType(pOperandContent->OperandZSTO),pOperandContent->display().toString())
2347// decode_ZType(wField.ZType),decode_OperandType(pOperandContent->OperandZSTO),displayOperandContent(pOperandContent).toString())
2348
2349 return wSt;
2350} // getFieldOperandContentWModifier

2586ZStatus getLiteralOperandContent(void *pLiteral, ZOperandContent* pOperandContent)
2587{
2588// ZOperandContent pOpContent;
2589 pOperandContent->clear();
2590 ZSearchOperandBase* wOpBase = static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(pLiteral);
2591
2592 if (!(wOpBase->ZSTO & ZSTO_Literal) ) {
2593 _DBGPRINT("getLiteralOperandContent-E-INVTYP Operand type is not literal.\n")
2594 return ZS_INVTYPE;
2595 }
2596
2597 int wOpType = wOpBase->ZSTO & ZSTO_BaseMask;
2598 pOperandContent->OperandZSTO = ZSearchOperandType(wOpType);
2599 switch (pOperandContent->OperandZSTO) {
2600 case ZSTO_String: {
2601 pOperandContent->setString( (static_cast<ZSearchLiteral*>(pLiteral)->getString()));
2602 pOperandContent->OperandZSTO = ZSTO_String;
2603 break;
2604 }
2605 case ZSTO_UriString: {
2606 pOperandContent->setURI (static_cast<ZSearchLiteral*>(pLiteral)->getURI());
2607 pOperandContent->OperandZSTO = ZSTO_UriString;
2608 break;
2609 }
2610 case ZSTO_Integer: {
2611 pOperandContent->setInteger ( static_cast<ZSearchLiteral*>(pLiteral)->getInteger());
2612 pOperandContent->OperandZSTO = ZSTO_Integer;
2613 break;
2614 }
2615 case ZSTO_Float: {
2616 pOperandContent->setFloat ( static_cast<ZSearchLiteral*>(pLiteral)->getFloat());
2617 pOperandContent->OperandZSTO = ZSTO_Float;
2618 break;
2619 }
2620 case ZSTO_Date: {
2621 pOperandContent->setDate ( static_cast<ZSearchLiteral*>(pLiteral)->getDate());
2622 pOperandContent->OperandZSTO = ZSTO_Date;
2623 break;
2624 }
2625 case ZSTO_Resource: {
2626 pOperandContent->setResource ( static_cast<ZSearchLiteral*>(pLiteral)->getResource());
2627 pOperandContent->OperandZSTO = ZSTO_Resource;
2628 break;
2629 }
2630 case ZSTO_Checksum: {
2631 pOperandContent->setChecksum ( static_cast<ZSearchLiteral*>(pLiteral)->getChecksum());
2632 pOperandContent->OperandZSTO = ZSTO_Checksum;
2633 break;
2634 }
2635 case ZSTO_Bool: {
2636 pOperandContent->setBool ( static_cast<ZSearchLiteral*>(pLiteral)->getBool());
2637 pOperandContent->OperandZSTO = ZSTO_Bool;
2638 break;
2639 }
2640 default:
2641 _DBGPRINT("getLiteralOperandContent-E-INVTYP Invalid literal operand type<%s> <0x%X>\n",
2642 decode_OperandType(wOpType),wOpType)
2643
2644 return ZS_INVTYPE;
2645 }//switch
2646
2647 _DBGPRINT("getLiteralOperandContent literal operand type<%s> value <%s>\n",
2648 decode_OperandType(pOperandContent->OperandZSTO),pOperandContent->display().toString())
2649
2650 return ZS_SUCCESS;
2651} // getLiteralOperandContent
2652
2653//ZStatus extractOperandContent (void* pOperand,URFParser& pURFParser,ZOperandContent* pOperandContent)
2654ZStatus extractOperandContent(ZSearchEntityContext &pSEC,
2655 void *pOperand,
2656 ZOperandContent *pOperandContent)
2657
2658{
2659// URFParser wURFParser(pRecord);
2660
2661 ZStatus wSt=ZS_SUCCESS;
2662 URFField wField;
2663 pOperandContent->clear();
2664
2665 URFParser* wParser=nullptr;
2666/*
2667 if (pURFParser.URFPS < URFPS_TotallyParsed) {
2668 _DBGPRINT("extractOperandContent-E-NOTPARSED Given parser is not up to date while parsing field rank <%d> name <%s>.\n",
2669 wOpFieldData->MetaDicRank,wOpFieldData->FullFieldName.toCChar(),decode_ZStatus(wSt))
2670 abort();
2671 }
2672*/
2673// ZOperandContent wContent ;
2674 ZSearchOperandBase* wOpBase=static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(pOperand);
2675 if (wOpBase->ZSTO & ZSTO_Field) {
2676 ZSearchFieldOperand* wOpFieldData=static_cast<ZSearchFieldOperand*>(pOperand);
2677 wParser=pSEC.getParserFromEntity(wOpFieldData->Entity);
2678
2679 wSt = wParser->_getURFFieldByRank(wOpFieldData->MetaDicRank,wField );
2680 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
2681 _DBGPRINT("gettermOperandContent-E-NOTFND Field rank <%d> name <%s> has not been found by URFParser with status <%s>\n",
2682 wOpFieldData->MetaDicRank,wOpFieldData->FullFieldName.toCChar(),decode_ZStatus(wSt))
2683 return ZS_MISS_FIELD;
2684 }
2685
2686
2687
2688 if (!wField.Present) {
2689 _DBGPRINT("gettermOperandContent-E-MISSFLD Field rank <%d> name <%s> is declared missing by URFParser.\n",
2690 wOpFieldData->MetaDicRank,wOpFieldData->FullFieldName.toCChar())
2691 return ZS_MISS_FIELD;
2692 }
2693 /* here field has been extracted from record according its position
2694 * VERIFY it is the correct field (ZType).
2695 * If not, then dictionary is not adapted to record
2696 */
2697 if (wField.ZType != wOpFieldData->getZType()) {
2698 _DBGPRINT("gettermOperandContent Field extracted from record at rank %ld has type <%s> while dictionary mentions <%s>.\n"
2699 " Either dictionary is invalid or Record is corrupted.",
2700 wOpFieldData->MetaDicRank,decode_ZType(wField.ZType),decode_ZType(wOpFieldData->getZType()));
2701 return ZS_CORRUPTED;
2702 }
2703
2704 wSt = getURFOperandContent (wField,pOperandContent);
2705 } // ZSTO_Field
2706 else {
2707 wSt = getLiteralOperandContent( pOperand,pOperandContent);
2708 } // ZSTO_Literal
2709
2710 if (wOpBase->ModifierType==ZSRCH_NOTHING)
2711 return ZS_SUCCESS;
2712
2713
2714 switch(wOpBase->ModifierType) {
2715 /* uristring modifiers */
2716 case ZSRCH_PATH:
2717 pOperandContent->replaceWithURI ( uriString(pOperandContent->getURI().getDirectoryPath()));
2718
2719 break;
2720 case ZSRCH_EXTENSION:
2721 pOperandContent->replaceWithString ( pOperandContent->getURI().getFileExtension());
2722
2723 break;
2724 case ZSRCH_BASENAME:
2725 pOperandContent->replaceWithString ( pOperandContent->getURI().getBasename());
2726 break;
2727 case ZSRCH_ROOTNAME:
2728 pOperandContent->replaceWithString ( pOperandContent->getURI().getRootname());
2729 break;
2730
2731 /* Date modifier */
2732 case ZSRCH_YEAR:
2733 pOperandContent->replaceWithInteger ( pOperandContent->getDate().year());
2734 break;
2735 case ZSRCH_MONTH:
2736 pOperandContent->replaceWithInteger ( pOperandContent->getDate().month());
2737 pOperandContent->OperandZSTO = ZSTO_Integer;
2738 break;
2739 case ZSRCH_DAY:
2740 pOperandContent->replaceWithInteger ( pOperandContent->getDate().day());
2741 break;
2742 case ZSRCH_HOUR:
2743 pOperandContent->replaceWithInteger (pOperandContent->getDate().hour());
2744 break;
2745 case ZSRCH_MIN:
2746 pOperandContent->replaceWithInteger ( pOperandContent->getDate().min());
2747 break;
2748 case ZSRCH_SEC:
2749 pOperandContent->replaceWithInteger (pOperandContent->getDate().sec());
2750 break;
2751
2752 /* resource modifier */
2753 case ZSRCH_ZENTITY:
2754 pOperandContent->replaceWithInteger (pOperandContent->getResource().Entity);
2755 break;
2756 case ZSRCH_ID:
2757 pOperandContent->replaceWithInteger ( pOperandContent->getResource().id);
2758 break;
2759 }
2760
2761 return ZS_SUCCESS;
2762} // gettermOperandContent

2764ZStatus
2765evaluateTermString(bool &pOutResult,ZOperandContent& pOp1,ZOperandContent& pOp2,ZSearchOperator& pOperator)
2766{
2767 ZSearchOperandType_type wType = pOp2.OperandZSTO & ZSTO_BaseMask;
2768 /* manage possible conversions */
2769 switch (wType)
2770 {
2771 case ZSTO_String:
2772 break;
2773 case ZSTO_UriString:
2774 {
2775 utf8VaryingString wD = pOp2.getURI();
2776 pOp2.setString (wD );
2777 break;
2778 }
2779 case ZSTO_Bool:
2780 {
2781 utf8VaryingString wD = pOp2.getBool()?"TRUE":"FALSE";
2782 pOp2.setString(wD);
2783 break;
2784 }
2785 case ZSTO_Integer:
2786 {
2787 utf8VaryingString wD;
2788 wD.sprintf("%ld",pOp2.getInteger());
2789 pOp2.setString(wD);
2790 break;
2791 }
2792 case ZSTO_Float:
2793 {
2794 utf8VaryingString wD;
2795 wD.sprintf("%g",pOp2.getFloat());
2796 pOp2.setString(wD);
2797 break;
2798 }
2799 case ZSTO_Date:
2800 {
2801 utf8VaryingString wD;
2802 wD=pOp2.getDate().toUTCGMT();
2803 pOp2.setString(wD);
2804 break;
2805 }
2806 case ZSTO_Checksum:
2807 {
2808 utf8VaryingString wD;
2809 wD=pOp2.getChecksum().toHexa();
2810 pOp2.setString(wD);
2811 break;
2812 }
2813 case ZSTO_Resource:
2814 {
2815 utf8VaryingString wD;
2816 wD=pOp2.getResource().toHexa();
2817 pOp2.setString(wD);
2818 break;
2819 }
2820 } // switch
2821
2822 switch (pOperator.ZSOPV)
2823 {
2824 case ZSOPV_EQUAL:
2825 pOutResult = pOp1.getString().compare(pOp2.getString())==0;
2826 break;
2827 case ZSOPV_NOTEQUAL:
2828 pOutResult = pOp1.getString().compare(pOp2.getString())!=0;
2829 break;
2830 case ZSOPV_LESS:
2831 pOutResult = pOp1.getString() .compare(pOp2.getString())<0;
2832 break;
2833 case ZSOPV_GREATER:
2834 pOutResult = pOp1.getString().compare(pOp2.getString())>0;
2835 break;
2836 case ZSOPV_LESSEQUAL:
2837 pOutResult = pOp1.getString().compare(pOp2.getString())<=0;
2838 break;
2839 case ZSOPV_GREATEREQUAL:
2840 pOutResult = pOp1.getString().compare(pOp2.getString())>=0;
2841 break;
2842
2843 case ZSOPV_CONTAINS:
2844 pOutResult = pOp1.getString().contains(pOp2.getString().toString());
2845 break;
2846 case ZSOPV_STARTS_WITH:
2847 pOutResult = pOp1.getString().startsWith(pOp2.getString().toString());
2848 break;
2849 case ZSOPV_ENDS_WITH:
2850 pOutResult = pOp1.getString().endsWith(pOp2.getString().toString());
2851 break;
2852 default:
2853 pOutResult = false;
2854 _DBGPRINT("evaluateTermString Invalid operator for type string logical compare operator %s\n",decode_ZSOPV(pOperator.ZSOPV))
2855 return ZS_INV_OPERATOR;
2856 }
2857 return ZS_SUCCESS;
2858}

2860ZStatus
2861evaluateLogicalTermInteger(bool & pOutReturn,ZOperandContent& pOp1,ZOperandContent& pOp2,ZSearchOperator& pOperator)
2862{
2863 ZSearchOperandType_type wType = pOp2.OperandZSTO & ZSTO_BaseMask;
2864 long wIntOp2=0;
2865 /* manage possible conversions */
2866 switch (wType)
2867 {
2868 case ZSTO_String:
2869 wIntOp2= pOp2.getString().toLong();
2870 break;
2871 case ZSTO_Integer:
2872 wIntOp2=pOp2.getInteger();
2873 break;
2874 case ZSTO_Float:
2875 wIntOp2= long(pOp2.getFloat());
2876 break;
2877
2878 case ZSTO_Bool:
2879 case ZSTO_UriString:
2880 case ZSTO_Date:
2881 case ZSTO_Checksum:
2882 _DBGPRINT("evaluateTermInteger Cannot compare integer (operand 1) with %s (operand 2) invalid result",
2883 decode_OperandType(wType))
2884 return ZS_INVOP;
2885 } // switch
2886
2887 switch (pOperator.ZSOPV)
2888 {
2889 case ZSOPV_EQUAL:
2890 pOutReturn = (pOp1.getInteger() == wIntOp2 ) ;
2891 break;
2892 case ZSOPV_NOTEQUAL:
2893 pOutReturn = ( pOp1.getInteger() != wIntOp2) ;
2894 break;
2895 case ZSOPV_LESS:
2896 pOutReturn = ( pOp1.getInteger() < wIntOp2);
2897 break;
2898 case ZSOPV_GREATER:
2899 pOutReturn = ( pOp1.getInteger() > wIntOp2);
2900 break;
2901 case ZSOPV_LESSEQUAL:
2902 pOutReturn = ( pOp1.getInteger() <= wIntOp2);
2903 break;
2904 case ZSOPV_GREATEREQUAL:
2905 pOutReturn = ( pOp1.getInteger() >= wIntOp2);
2906 break;
2907 default:
2908 _DBGPRINT("evaluateTermInteger Invalid operator for integer logical compare operation %s\n",decode_ZSOPV(pOperator.ZSOPV))
2909 pOutReturn = false;
2910 return ZS_INV_OPERATOR;
2911 }
2912 return ZS_SUCCESS;
2913} //evaluateLogicalTermInteger

2916#ifdef __COMMENT__ see ZSearchArithmeticTerm::computeArithmeticOperation()
2917ZStatus
2918evaluateArithmeticTermInteger(ZOperandContent& pOutReturn,ZOperandContent& pOp1,ZOperandContent& pOp2,ZSearchOperator& pOperator)
2919{
2920 ZSearchOperandType_type wType = pOp2.ZSTO & ZSTO_BaseMask;
2921 long wIntOp2=0;

2923 switch (wType)
2924 {
2925 case ZSTO_String:
2926 wIntOp2= pOp2.getString().toLong();
2927 break;
2928 case ZSTO_Integer:
2929 wIntOp2=pOp2.getInteger();
2930 break;
2931 case ZSTO_Float:
2932 wIntOp2= long(pOp2.getFloat());
2933 break;
2934
2935 case ZSTO_Bool:
2936 case ZSTO_UriString:
2937 case ZSTO_Date:
2938 case ZSTO_Checksum:
2939 _DBGPRINT("evaluateTermInteger Cannot compare integer (operand 1) with %s (operand 2) invalid result",
2940 decode_OperandType(wType))
2941 return ZS_INVOP;
2942 } // switch
2943
2944 switch (pOperator.ZSOPV)

2960 break;

2972
2973bool approximatelyEqual(double a, double b)
2974{
2975 return fabs(a - b) <= ((fabs(a) < fabs(b) ? fabs(b) : fabs(a)) * std::numeric_limits<double>::epsilon());
2976}

2978ZStatus
2979evaluateTermFloat(bool & pOutReturn,ZOperandContent& pOp1,ZOperandContent& pOp2,ZSearchOperator& pOperator)
2980{
2981 ZSearchOperandType_type wType = pOp2.OperandZSTO & ZSTO_BaseMask;
2982 double wFloatOp2=0.0;
2983 /* manage possible conversions */
2984 switch (wType)
2985 {
2986 case ZSTO_String:
2987 wFloatOp2 = pOp2.getString().toDouble();
2988 break;
2989 case ZSTO_Float:
2990 wFloatOp2 = pOp2.getFloat();
2991 break;
2992 case ZSTO_Integer:
2993 wFloatOp2 = double(pOp2.getInteger());
2994 break;
2995
2996 case ZSTO_Bool:
2997 case ZSTO_UriString:
2998 case ZSTO_Date:
2999 case ZSTO_Checksum:
3000 _DBGPRINT("evaluateTermFloat Cannot compare double (operand 1) with %s (operand 2) invalid result",
3001 decode_OperandType(wType))
3002 return ZS_INVOP;
3003 } // switch
3004
3005 switch (pOperator.ZSOPV)
3006 {
3007 case ZSOPV_EQUAL:
3008 pOutReturn = approximatelyEqual(pOp1.getFloat(), wFloatOp2) ;
3009 break;
3010 case ZSOPV_NOTEQUAL:
3011 pOutReturn = ! approximatelyEqual(pOp1.getFloat(), wFloatOp2);
3012 break;
3013 case ZSOPV_LESS:
3014 pOutReturn = ( pOp1.getFloat() < wFloatOp2);
3015 break;
3016 case ZSOPV_GREATER:
3017 pOutReturn = ( pOp1.getFloat() > wFloatOp2);
3018 break;
3019 case ZSOPV_LESSEQUAL:
3020 pOutReturn = ( pOp1.getFloat() < wFloatOp2) || approximatelyEqual(pOp1.getFloat(), wFloatOp2);
3021 break;
3022 case ZSOPV_GREATEREQUAL:
3023 pOutReturn = ( pOp1.getFloat() > wFloatOp2) || approximatelyEqual(pOp1.getFloat(), wFloatOp2);
3024 break;
3025 default:
3026 _DBGPRINT("evaluateTermFloat Invalid operator for type double logical compare %s\n",decode_ZSOPV(pOperator.ZSOPV))
3027 pOutReturn = false;
3028 return ZS_INV_OPERATOR;
3029 }
3030 return ZS_SUCCESS;
3031}

3033ZStatus
3034evaluateTermDate(bool &pOutResult,ZOperandContent& pOp1,ZOperandContent& pOp2,ZSearchOperator& pOperator)
3035{
3036 ZDatePrecision wDP=ZDTPR_nano;
3037
3038 ZDateFull wDateOp2;
3039
3040 ZSearchOperandType_type wType = pOp2.OperandZSTO & ZSTO_BaseMask;
3041 /* manage possible conversions */
3042 switch (wType)
3043 {
3044 case ZSTO_String:
3045 wDateOp2 = ZDateFull::fromString(pOp2.getString());
3046 break;
3047 case ZSTO_UriString:
3048 case ZSTO_Bool:
3049 case ZSTO_Integer:
3050 case ZSTO_Float:
3051 case ZSTO_Checksum:
3052 _DBGPRINT("evaluateTermDate Cannot compare tyoe ZDate (operand 1) with %s (operand 2) result set to invalid\n",
3053 decode_OperandType(pOp2.OperandZSTO))
3054 return ZS_INVOP;
3055
3056 case ZSTO_Date:
3057 wDateOp2 = pOp2.getDate();
3058 break;
3059 } // switch
3060
3061 switch (pOperator.ZSOPV)
3062 {
3063 case ZSOPV_EQUAL:
3064
3065// wDP = std::min(pOp1.getDate().Precision,pOp2.Date.Precision);
3066 wDP = pOp1.getDate().Precision;
3067
3068 pOutResult = pOp1.getDate()._Compare(wDateOp2,wDP)==0;
3069 break;
3070 case ZSOPV_NOTEQUAL:
3071 pOutResult = pOp1.getDate()._Compare(wDateOp2,wDP)!=0;
3072 break;
3073 case ZSOPV_LESS:
3074 pOutResult = pOp1.getDate()._Compare(wDateOp2,wDP) < 0;
3075 break;
3076 case ZSOPV_GREATER:
3077 pOutResult = pOp1.getDate()._Compare(wDateOp2,wDP) > 0;
3078 break;
3079 case ZSOPV_LESSEQUAL:
3080 pOutResult = pOp1.getDate()._Compare(wDateOp2,wDP)<=0;
3081 break;
3082 case ZSOPV_GREATEREQUAL:
3083 pOutResult = pOp1.getDate()._Compare(wDateOp2,wDP)>=0;
3084 break;
3085
3086 default:
3087 _DBGPRINT("Invalid operator for type ZDateFull logical compare operator %s\n",decode_ZSOPV(pOperator.ZSOPV))
3088 return ZS_INV_OPERATOR;
3089 }
3090 return ZS_SUCCESS;
3091}

3169/* Manage possible conversion then logical operation between two operands.
3170 * the first operand defines the conversion if necessary
3171 */
3172
3173ZStatus
3174evaluateTerm(bool &pOutResult,ZOperandContent& pOp1,ZOperandContent& pOp2,ZSearchOperator& pOperator)
3175{
3176
3177 ZSearchOperandType_type wType = pOp1.OperandZSTO & ZSTO_BaseMask;
3178 switch (wType)
3179 {
3180 case ZSTO_String:
3181 return evaluateTermString(pOutResult,pOp1,pOp2,pOperator);
3182 case ZSTO_Integer:
3183 return evaluateLogicalTermInteger(pOutResult,pOp1,pOp2,pOperator);
3184 case ZSTO_Float:
3185 return evaluateTermFloat(pOutResult,pOp1,pOp2,pOperator);
3186 case ZSTO_Date:
3187 return evaluateTermDate(pOutResult,pOp1,pOp2,pOperator);
3188 case ZSTO_Resource:
3189 return evaluateLogicalTermResource(pOutResult,pOp1,pOp2,pOperator);
3190 case ZSTO_Checksum:
3191 return evaluateTermChecksum(pOutResult,pOp1,pOp2,pOperator);
3192 default:
3193 _DBGPRINT("evaluateTerm-F-INVOP Invalid operand type %X %s\n",wType,decode_OperandType(wType))
3194 }
3195
3196 return ZS_INVOP;
3197}
3198
3199utf8VaryingString
3200OperandReportFormula(void * pOperand, bool pDetailed)
3201{
3202 utf8VaryingString wReturn;
3203 if (pOperand==nullptr) {
3204 wReturn="<NULL>";
3205 return wReturn;
3206 }
3207 ZSearchOperandBase* wOpBase=static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(pOperand);
3208 while (true) {
3209 if (wOpBase->ZSTO & ZSTO_Arithmetic) {
3210 wReturn.addsprintf("[%s]", static_cast<ZSearchArithmeticTerm*>(pOperand)->_reportFormula().toString());
3211 break;
3212 }
3213 if (wOpBase->ZSTO == ZSTO_Logical) {
3214 wReturn += static_cast<ZSearchLogicalTerm*>(pOperand)->_reportFormula(true);
3215 break;
3216 }
3217
3218 if (wOpBase->ZSTO & ZSTO_Field) {
3219 ZSearchFieldOperand* wFldData = static_cast<ZSearchFieldOperand*>( pOperand);
3220
3221 wReturn.addsprintf(" %s", wFldData->FullFieldName.toString() );
3222 break;
3223 }
3224 if (wOpBase->ZSTO & ZSTO_Literal) {
3225 wReturn.addsprintf(" %s",ZSearchLogicalOperand::_evaluateOpLiteral(pOperand).toString() );
3226 break;
3227 }
3228 wReturn.addsprintf("<Invalid type %s 0x%X >\n",
3229 decode_OperandType(static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(pOperand)->ZSTO),
3230 static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(pOperand)->ZSTO
3231 );
3232 break;
3233 }// while true
3234
3235 wReturn += wOpBase->_reportModifierBrief();
3236
3237 if (pDetailed) {
3238/*
3239 if (!static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(pOperand)->Comment.isEmpty()) {
3240 wReturn.addsprintf("(%s)",static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(pOperand)->Comment.toString());
3241 }
3242*/
3243 if (!wOpBase->FullFieldName.isEmpty() && !(wOpBase->ZSTO & ZSTO_Field)) {
3244 wReturn.addsprintf("[%s]",wOpBase->FullFieldName.toString());
3245 }
3246 }
3247
3248 wReturn += " ";
3249
3250 return wReturn;
3251} // OperandReportFormula
3252
3253utf8VaryingString
3254OperandReportDetailed(void* pOperand,int pLevel)
3255{
3256 utf8VaryingString wReturn;
3257
3258 ZSearchOperandBase* wOpBase = static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(pOperand);
3259
3260 wReturn.addsprintf("%*cOperand\n",pLevel,' ');
3261 while (true) {
3262 if (wOpBase->ZSTO == ZSTO_Arithmetic) {
3263 wReturn += static_cast<ZSearchArithmeticTerm*>(pOperand)->_report(pLevel+1);
3264 break;
3265 }
3266 if (wOpBase->ZSTO == ZSTO_Logical) {
3267 wReturn += static_cast<ZSearchLogicalTerm*>(pOperand)->_report(pLevel+1);
3268 break;
3269 }
3270
3271 if (wOpBase->ZSTO & ZSTO_Field) {
3272 ZSearchFieldOperand* wFldData = static_cast<ZSearchFieldOperand*>( pOperand);
3273 wReturn.addsprintf("%*c type %s full field name <%s> dictionary type <%s>\n",
3274 pLevel,' ',
3275 decode_OperandType(static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(pOperand)->ZSTO),
3276 wFldData->FullFieldName.toString(),
3277 decode_ZType(wFldData->getZType())
3278 );
3279 break;
3280 }
3281 if (wOpBase->ZSTO & ZSTO_Literal) {
3282 wReturn.addsprintf("%*c type %s value <%s>\n",
3283 pLevel,' ',
3284 decode_OperandType(wOpBase->ZSTO),
3285 OperandReportLiteral(pOperand).toString()
3286 );
3287 break;
3288 }
3289 wReturn.addsprintf("%*c type %s <Invalid type>\n",
3290 pLevel,' ',
3291 decode_OperandType(wOpBase->ZSTO)
3292 );
3293 break;
3294 }// while true
3295
3296 wReturn += wOpBase->_reportModifier(pLevel);
3297
3298 return wReturn;
3299} // OperandReportDetailed

3301utf8VaryingString
3302OperandReportLiteral(void *pOp)
3303{
3304 utf8VaryingString wReturn;
3305
3306 if (!(static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(pOp)->ZSTO & ZSTO_Literal)) {
3307 wReturn.sprintf("_evaluateOpLiteral-E-INVTYP Invalid type to evaluate <%s>",
3308 decode_OperandType(static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(pOp)->ZSTO));
3309 return wReturn;
3310 }
3311 switch (static_cast<const ZSearchOperandBase*>(pOp)->ZSTO )
3312 {
3313 case ZSTO_LiteralString:
3314 {
3315 ZSearchLiteral* wOp=static_cast<ZSearchLiteral*>(pOp);
3316 wReturn.sprintf("\"%s\"",wOp->getString());
3317 // return wOp->Content;
3318 return wReturn;

3320 case ZSTO_LiteralUriString:
3321 {

3324 }
3325 case ZSTO_LiteralInteger:
3326 {
3327 ZSearchLiteral* wOp=static_cast<ZSearchLiteral*>(pOp);

3330 }
3331 case ZSTO_LiteralFloat:
3332 {
3333 ZSearchLiteral* wOp=static_cast<ZSearchLiteral*>(pOp);

3338 {

3342 case ZSTO_LiteralResource:
3343 {
3344 ZSearchLiteral* wOp=static_cast<ZSearchLiteral*>(pOp);
3345 // return wOp->Content.toHexa();
3346 long wi=0;
3347 for (;wi < ZEntitySymbolList.count();wi++) {
3348 if (ZEntitySymbolList[wi].Value==wOp->getResource().Entity) {
3349 break;
3350 }
3351 }// for
3352 if (wi==ZEntitySymbolList.count())
3353 wReturn.sprintf("ZResource(%6X,%6X)",wOp->getResource().Entity,wOp->getResource().id);

3356 return wReturn;
3357 }
3358 case ZSTO_LiteralBool:
3359 {
3360 ZSearchLiteral* wOp=static_cast<ZSearchLiteral*>(pOp);
3361 return wOp->getBool()?"TRUE":"FALSE";
3362 }
3363 case ZSTO_LiteralChecksum:
3364 {

3366 // return wOp->Content.toHexa();

3370 default:
3371 {
3372 wReturn.sprintf("_evaluateOpLiteral-E-INVTYP Invalid type to evaluate <%s>",
3373 decode_OperandType(static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(pOp)->ZSTO));
3374 return wReturn;

3376

3381void clearOperand(void *&pOp)
3382{
3383 if (pOp==nullptr)
3384 return;
3385 if (static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(pOp)->ZSTO & ZSTO_Arithmetic)
3386 {

3388 pOp=nullptr;

3391 if (static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(pOp)->ZSTO & ZSTO_Logical)
3392 {

3394 pOp=nullptr;
3395 return;

3397
3398 if (static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(pOp)->ZSTO & ZSTO_Field)
3399 {
3400 delete static_cast<ZSearchFieldOperand*>(pOp);
3401 pOp=nullptr;
3402 return;
3403 }
3404
3405 if (static_cast<ZSearchOperandBase*>(pOp)->ZSTO & ZSTO_Literal) {
3406 delete static_cast<ZSearchLiteral*>(pOp);
3407 pOp=nullptr;
3408 return;
3409 }
3410 pOp=nullptr;
3411 return;

3945 case TSST_MissArithTerm:
3946 return "TSST_MissArithTerm";
3947 case TSST_Other:
3948 return "TSST_Other";
3949 default:
3950 return "Unknown Term Scan Status";
3951 }
